items.title: Joel Dorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2007
items.q: And I think I had Zagorski, Stanislaw Zagorski who had done all those great illustrations on the Atlantic Records, I think he did a painting of David with a raincoat full ‘o buckles.

ctx.x: That’s with Blue Mitchell. I loved that. Now this is imbecilic. I loved that record but I didn’t recognize that record. Yeah that was a great little record, “Captain” — and you know where we got the title from that? Fathead came in, right? And it was like I don’t know maybe middle of winter or end of winter, or something in there, and it was chilly outside and it was raining. And he had a brand new raincoat. And you know, like really stylish, with all kinds of buckles and bells and whistles and buttons and…
I love that when you’ve done so much work that —
